exposure: Adherence to 2012 NICHD criteria for labor arrest and failed induction
outcome: Primary Cesarean delivery due to arrest of dilation
Primary Cesarean delivery due to arrest of descent
cohort: The study included 17,877 live births at a large academic center from 2010 through 2013.
finding: Increased adherence to the 2012 NICHD criteria for labor arrest was associated with a decrease in primary Cesarean delivery rate, primarily driven by a reduction in Cesareans for arrest of dilation.
